verdict.rationale: Pylon documents default analytics dashboards with common support metrics, scheduled AI Reports that summarize data into Slack, Ask AI for questions over existing data, and AI fields that roll qualitative insights into structured fields. Together these could help a support leader spot trends, but none of them explicitly clusters conversations by topic or proactively flags emerging issues before volume spikes. Missing for 10: explicit topic clustering of conversations, emerging-issue or anomaly detection ahead of ticket spikes, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
